title: Ultima Online: Outlands
notes: Not the official Ultima Online: Outlands accepts only the clients from its own launcher (custom ClassicUO 1.0.2.562 and Razor Outlands Edition). Logged in and walked around Shelter Island, about 25 min over several sessions, on a 27" 4K 120 Hz display. FPS not measured (no Metal HUD). Setup: - New environment, run Outlands.exe from https://patch.uooutlands.com/download as a Windows program. Keep the default folder C:\Program Files (x86)\Ultima Online Outlands, then Verify, then Play Now. - Pin the installed C:\Program Files (x86)\Ultima Online Outlands\Outlands.exe, not ClassicUO.exe, so the launcher keeps patching the game. - No .NET install is needed. The Outlands wiki says to install .NET Desktop Runtime 5.0.17, but the current launcher bundles .NET 9.0.7 and the client has its own runtime. Tested: the launcher, the game and Razor run with no .NET installed in the environment. Sharp picture on a HiDPI display (4K at 2x scaling, or a Mac Retina screen): - Environment scale 200% (192 dpi). The launcher and Razor then draw at full resolution at normal size. - In ClassicUO, set Display Scale to twice your usual value (220 here, settings.json "display_scale"). At 100% everything draws at 1x and macOS blurs it. - ClassicUO fps 120 for a 120 Hz display. FNA3D runs on D3D11 through DXMT, at about half of one CPU core.
